notes: Extracted 29 October 2026 from the guide and docs/evidence/brandchip.md at 31f1c5e. The guide's Sources note and the evidence were checked on 23 September 2026 against jfs-components 0.1.60 and never re-checked, so every item resting on them carries 0.1.60 and is flagged; the Sources sentence that declared, installed and registry versions are 0.1.60 is stale and not used. Installed build: jfs-components 0.1.78, mirror v0.1.78-dbe0e02 (Biscuit's main at dbe0e02, 27 October). Its BrandChip.tsx still matches everything the guide and evidence say, read from source, not run: the props (label, imageSource, avatarSlot, onPress, modes, accessibilityLabel, disableTruncation, plus style and labelStyle); the label is one line with a tail ellipsis unless disableTruncation is set, and has no flex shrink; the chip hugs its content (alignSelf flex-start); its avatar gets Avatar Size S unless the chip's modes set another, and the avatarSlot gets the chip's modes recursively (the slot's own modes win); imageSource is ignored when avatarSlot is given; nothing swaps a failed image for a monogram (Avatar has no image-error handling either); onPress makes it a Pressable, and there is no selected or disabled prop. Nothing in the guide is contradicted by dbe0e02. The guide names no other component to use instead, so the avoidWhen rule (a status in place of the account) has no useInstead: it sends the status to nearby content. The package's own doc says the chip often shows the currently selected account in selectors; the guide does not, so it is not recorded, but it is why the missing selected state is kept as a gap. Examples follow the building rules: no Color Mode (the guide sets Light on every chip, and on the In context Card and VStack) and no other modes; the press handler is a stub. Their copy is the guide's own: Axis Bank • 0245 and Axis Bank • 1182, the AB monogram Avatar in avatarSlot, and Paying from. Avatar has no entry in this pack; the examples use it because the guide supplies the monogram that way. Left out of examples: the Horizon Bank / HB configuration preview (a second brand shows nothing the AB chip doesn't), the narrow and roomy hosts (documentation frames), and the playground's status readout (documentation chrome). Not recorded: style and labelStyle, which the building rules keep off Coin components; disableTruncation, which the guide never uses and whose wrapping with no flex shrink was not checked; the mode collections the evidence does not describe (Badge Size, context 10, Context2, Context4, Page type, Profile Card Appearance); the static chip's screen-reader name (not a Coin gap, per the pack's rules); and the evidence's pending mobile-fit visual QA.

<Card variant="slim">

    <Text>Paying from</Text>

    />
  </VStack>
</Card>

evidenceFacts.name: label
evidenceFacts.description: One line by default, and the label lacks flex shrink: the chip hugs its content, so a long label is not promised to fit a narrow host (the guide's long-label example runs past its 240 px host).
evidenceFacts.quote: It hugs content; its label is one line by default and lacks flex shrink

evidenceFacts.name: avatarSlot
evidenceFacts.description: Gets the chip's modes recursively and Avatar Size S by default. BrandChip does not replace a failed image with a monogram: a monogram is an Avatar the screen puts in the slot.
evidenceFacts.quote: Brand Chip forwards its modes recursively and defaults the slot Avatar to S; it does not automatically replace a failed image with a monogram.

evidenceFacts.name: Avatar Size
evidenceFacts.description: BrandChip shows its avatar at S (29 px, Figma's size) unless its modes set Avatar Size.
evidenceFacts.quote: contains an Avatar at S size (29px)

gaps.text: The label has no flex shrink, so a long label can run past a narrow host: the guide’s long-label example exceeds its 240 px host. Keep identifiers short.
